    A LITTLE PERSPECTIVE

    Meet your planet.

    WorldScope brings satellite imagery, real terrain and the stories of places together in one interactive atlas.

    Move aroundDrag with one finger.
    Get closerPinch or use + and −.
    Change perspectiveTwo-finger drag to tilt.
    Discover a placeTap a marker or anywhere on land. Submit a search for more locations.

    Country comparisons

    Population and GDP: World Bank World Development Indicators. Military expenditure: SIPRI, distributed through World Bank WDI, in current US dollars. Colors compare a single reporting year on a logarithmic scale. Missing figures are gray. Data is fetched on demand; cached figures show their retrieval date. Military spending does not measure overall military strength. Natural Earth 1:110m geometry omits some small countries; rankings cover mapped countries only. Boundaries are approximate and may be disputed.

    Sources & imagery

    3D engine: CesiumJS (Apache 2.0). Overview basemap: Natural Earth, public domain, distributed with CesiumJS. Satellite and elevation: Esri and its data partners; imagery dates and detail vary by location. Night: NASA GIBS / VIIRS Black Marble, 2016 composite, approximately 500 m resolution. Borders: Natural Earth, public domain; boundaries are approximate and may be disputed. Clouds: historical NASA imagery via WebGL Earth, illustrative rather than live. Place information and photos: Wikipedia / Wikimedia; articles CC BY-SA, photos retain their individual licenses. Search fallback: © OpenStreetMap contributors via Nominatim.

    Internet access is required for maps and live place information. Public services can be unavailable or rate-limited. Saved places stay on this device. This is an exploration tool, not a navigation service.
